Tenfold helps companies have better customer conversations by putting the customer information into action on the phone in real-time.

The company's software enables businesses to have better customer conversations. Its intelligent integrated desktop agent amplifies good customer engagement technology. 

Tenfold brings together the power of voice and intelligence of CRM for better customer conversations.

about_short_description.short_description: Tenfold helps companies have better customer conversations by putting customer information into action on the phone.

product.name: Tenfold Customer Experience Cloud
product.description: A cloud-based platform that integrates CRM and communication systems to provide real-time customer context and automate agent workflows during calls.

product.name: Tenfold CTI Integration
product.description: A computer telephony integration service that connects phone systems with CRM platforms to synchronize customer data and call activities.

product.name: Tenfold Sales Productivity Tools
product.description: A suite of tools within Tenfold that automates sales call logging, provides click-to-dial functionality, and delivers actionable sales performance insights.

product.name: Tenfold Workflow Automation
product.description: Automation features that reduce manual tasks for agents by streamlining data entry, call logging, and other repetitive activities during customer interactions.

product.name: Tenfold Performance Insights and Analytics
product.description: A reporting and analytics service that provides real-time visibility into agent and team performance metrics to support coaching and operational decisions.
